summary: The Godfather game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The Godfather
entries.definitive_edition: The Godfather: The Don's Edition on PS3, with PC and Wii versions documented for capture/control differences

emulation.emulator: RPCS3 optional for Don's Edition; PC native for launch route
emulation.notes: Use original PS3 hardware if motion-control fidelity matters.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS3 Don's Edition for complete HD route; PC for capture/fix comparison

primary.why: The Don's Edition is the most complete high-definition route, adding the Corleone Expansion Pack and PS3 motion/BlackHand features over the original release. PC is useful for capture and mod/fix work, but is less complete than the later PS3/Wii expanded versions.
primary.how_to_play: Use The Don's Edition on PS3 or RPCS3 if original hardware is impractical. Record edition, patch/DLC state, motion-control handling, family compound progression, favor/hit missions, extortion/racket completion, and whether PC, Wii Blackhand Edition, Xbox 360, or PSP Mob Wars were compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original/HD capture route without Don's Edition additions
secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting launch-version or PC compatibility behavior.
secondary.why: PS3 Don's Edition is more complete, but PC/Xbox 360 are important comparison routes.

secondary.exclusive_content: Motion-control focused version with expanded content
secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting Wii gesture controls.
secondary.why: It shares expanded-version lineage but has lower visual fidelity than PS3.
It is not equivalent to the open-world console/PC route.

all_releases.reason: secondary: launch baseline and PC compatibility comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: HD console route with later-generation presentation.
